Check a rulebook

Source: R/validate.R
validate_rulebook.Rd

Checks a rulebook in three passes:

Usage

validate_rulebook(rb)

Arguments

rb

A plancap_rulebook.

Value

A plancap_validation: a list with valid (no errors) and issues, a data frame of severity, path and message.

Details

  1. Structure, against the JSON Schema (rulebook_schema_path()): every key known, every value the right type. A misspelt key is an error, not silently ignored.

  2. Consistency: every zone, family, overlay and layer a rule refers to exists; bands ascend; formulas use only known variables; each zone has what its method needs.

  3. Lint (warnings): values without a citation, zones no code maps to, rules that nothing will read.

Examples

rb <- rulebook("Exampleton") |>
  add_zone(zone("LDR", height = height_limit(8)))
validate_rulebook(rb)
#> ✔ Rulebook is valid (2 warnings, 1 note).
#> ! /zones/LDR: no citation anywhere in this zone
#> ! /zones/LDR/height: height has no source
#> ℹ /conversion: no floor area to dwellings conversion; dwellings need one at run
#>   time
